description: Header file defining function prototypes, macros, and external references for AMR encoding in the libstagefright media framework, including initialization, reset, exit, and encoding functions, as well as related constants and external variables.

methods.name: AMREncodeInit
methods.description: Initializes the AMR encoder and sid sync structures, with optional DTX enablement.

methods.name: AMREncodeReset
methods.description: Resets the encoder and sid sync structures to their initial state.

methods.name: AMREncodeExit
methods.description: Releases resources associated with the encoder and sid sync structures.

methods.name: AMREncode
methods.description: Performs encoding of input speech frames into AMR frames with specified output format.
